definitions.gloss: cushioning material; packing material; shock-absorbing material
definitions.explanation: Material used to protect fragile items during shipping or storage, such as bubble wrap, foam peanuts, or air pillows.

examples.japanese: {緩衝|かんしょう}{材|ざい}を{入|い}れて{送|おく}ってください。
examples.english: Please pack it with cushioning material before shipping.

examples.japanese: {割|わ}れ{物|もの}なので、{緩衝|かんしょう}{材|ざい}をたっぷり{使|つか}った。
examples.english: Since it's fragile, I used plenty of cushioning material.

examples.japanese: フリマアプリで{売|う}った{商品|しょうひん}を{発送|はっそう}するとき、{緩衝|かんしょう}{材|ざい}が{足|た}りなくて{困|こま}った。
examples.english: When shipping a product I sold on a flea market app, I was stuck because I didn't have enough packing material.

notes:
USAGE:
Common in shipping, packaging, and online commerce contexts. With the rise of online shopping and flea market apps like メルカリ, this word appears frequently in everyday life.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {緩衝|かんしょう}{材|ざい}を{入|い}れる (to put in cushioning material)
- {緩衝|かんしょう}{材|ざい}で{包|つつ}む (to wrap in packing material)
- {緩衝|かんしょう}{材|ざい}が{足|た}りない (not enough cushioning material)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- プチプチ: bubble wrap — the colloquial onomatopoeic name for bubble wrap
- {梱包|こんぽう}{材|ざい}: packing material — broader term for all packaging supplies
